newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambian stocks week - Shares steady in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Zambian stocks week - Shares steady in slow trade.

text.p: Activity slowed on the Lusaka Stock Exchange last week, with most shares trading steady, dealers said.
Officials at the bourse said traded volume fell to 106,184 shares worth 1,143,654 kwacha, down from 220,950 shares valued at 2,378,409 kwacha the previous week.
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 12 kwacha after 50,377 shares worth 604,524 kwacha changed hands and Farmers House also traded unchanged at 240.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) saw no trades in the week.
Chilanga Cement fell two kwacha to end the week at 53 kwacha but Rothmans rose two kwacha to 34.
